description: Historical, county-level road network statistics for the conterminous United States (1900 - 2015) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Johannes H. Uhl, Keith Burghardt. This CSV file contains geometric and topological road network statistics for the majority of counties in the conterminous U.S. The underlying road network data is the USGS-NTD v2019. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4185143 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
